outline.rationale: The user is a total beginner aiming to plan and run a real study soon, so the outline is sequenced as a practical end-to-end pipeline. Node 1 gives just enough foundational grounding (what research is / why) without dwelling on theory or history. Nodes 2–3 cover framing and method selection, which are the highest-leverage early decisions for a first-timer. Nodes 4–6 are the concrete execution skills (recruiting, question design, facilitation) that beginners most often get wrong. Nodes 7–8 close the loop on synthesis and acting on findings — otherwise a study is wasted. I deliberately excluded quantitative/statistical analysis, surveys, and specialized methods per the confirmed scope, and avoided an intro/conclusion node. Siblings are MECE: each maps to a distinct stage of doing a study with minimal overlap.
